title: I had to use what I received
text:
I had to use what I received. Did receive two signs for $15.99 each. Loved them so much I ordered matching ribbon from another supplier. I received the signs as I photographed.
I gave 4 stars because I used them
The writing on the sign is in cursive, that’s why I ordered the signs with block letters just like my ribbon and as pictured in the item description. The company that they were shipped from said they don’t make mistakes. So for my $30.00 investment I had to use them
